# bibisco

> > bibisco is a comprehensive novel writing software designed to help authors plan, write, and organize their stories across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.

bibisco is a cross-platform writing tool created by Andrea Feccomandi that serves as a Scrivener alternative for novelists. The platform offers features for character development, story planning, scene management, and manuscript organization, with support for multiple export formats including PDF, DOCX, and EPUB.
